name: codex-chinese
description: Force the Codex desktop app to use its built-in zh-CN interface, even when Statsig/VPN is unreachable.

install_windows.shortcut_rule: shortcut TargetPath MUST be codex-chinese*.exe; never wscript.exe/cmd.exe/.vbs/.bat

diagnose_windows.note: Prints OS, MSIX package path, aliases, running processes, CDP port, and with -TryLaunch a real launch test. Ask the user to paste the whole output.

failure_modes.exit_1_installed_false: running but not injected (e.g. shortcut bypasses codex-chinese.exe)
failure_modes.exit_1_i18n_false: marker present but patch missed the Statsig layer; upgrade to v1.2.0+
failure_modes.exit_2: no CDP port; Codex not launched with --remote-debugging-port or already exited

run.requires: Codex desktop app installed; user must fully quit Codex first
run.notes: Launches Codex with --remote-debugging-port, injects a prelude over CDP, then reloads once.

golden_path.summary: Run codex-chinese*.exe directly so it launches Codex with --remote-debugging-port, inject, then require -verify exit code 0. Never wrap it in a launcher script.
do: install via scripts/install_windows.ps1 or the release binary
point every shortcut TargetPath at codex-chinese.exe or codex-chinese-tray.exe
fully quit Codex (including tray icon) before running — Electron is single-instance and a second process would just hand over its args and exit
run -doctor first and confirm the 'codex:' line shows a real path (MSIX store builds resolve via registry)
require -verify exit code 0 and a stdout line 'verify: installed=true lang=zh-CN i18n=true'
tell the user how to use it after deploy (see post_deploy)
do_not: create shortcuts whose TargetPath is wscript.exe or cmd.exe
treat '完成：Codex 已强制中文', a running process, or the presence of a shortcut as success
launch Codex manually before injecting (the debug port would not be open)
drop the CDP session before the reloaded page has executed the prelude
hardcode a WindowsApps versioned path such as OpenAI.Codex_26.1013.4894.0_x64__2p2nqsd0c76g0 (the version changes on every update)
scan WindowsApps with glob/find (the directory is not listable by normal users)

required_points: artifact location under dist/ and which file to use on this platform
how to start: Windows tray exe (right-click -> force Chinese) or CLI exe; macOS/Linux CLI
prerequisite: fully quit Codex including tray icon before running
success marker: -verify exits 0 with a line 'verify: installed=true lang=zh-CN i18n=true' (the printed line '完成：Codex 已强制中文' is NOT a success marker)
reminder: re-run after each Codex restart, or keep the tray app running
troubleshooting: port timeout, macOS quarantine, Windows SmartScreen
verification: run codex-chinese -verify and require exit code 0 (PASS) before claiming success
the PASS line must read i18n=true; installed=true with i18n=false means the patch missed the layer
post_deploy.user_message_template: 部署完成 ✅ Windows 推荐用 scripts/install_windows.ps1 安装（或双击 codex-chinese-tray-windows-amd64.exe，与 codex-chinese.exe 放同一目录）。使用前请先完全退出 Codex（含托盘图标），再右键托盘图标选「立即强制中文」。用 codex-chinese.exe -verify 校验，输出 verify: installed=true lang=zh-CN i18n=true 且 PASS 才算成功。每次重启 Codex 后需再执行一次。
